Chips

My parents did always try to hide chips from me, as I loved eating them
way too much — but they were never successful at hiding them. As bad as
my
experience
in
that
household
was,
these
chips
were
a
stress
reliever
and a sort of safe haven. I want you to get a taste of the delicious safe
havens in the form of food that I had when I was younger.
